utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want me to help organize the repair drive, or are you already set?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can cover the two houses on Maple and the corner place on Pine.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll take the rest. Do you want me to start with the east side or the folks near the park?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over whatever tools we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Gus. I’ll try to keep track and let you know what turns up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — just give me a shout when you know what’s needed, and I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a nice turnout this week—folks seem pretty eager to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear, but I’m still wondering if we’ve got enough boxes and a clear drop-off plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can ask around about extra boxes and see if someone’s sorting out the drop-off spot. If you want, I’ll bring back whatever I hear.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you let me know where the drive items are being dropped off, and which street corner you’re using for pickup?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: They’re being dropped off at my place on Maple, and I’m using the corner by the old bakery for pickup. If that changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive’s coming together nicely — I’m telling everyone to swing by and lend a hand. If you want, I can save you a spot and bring you up to speed there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I might stop by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep a spot open for you and fill you in when you get there. Even a little time would help a lot!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive organized, Leo—just tell me what you want on the list first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Put me down for the porch light and the loose gate hinge.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ve got you down for the porch light and the loose gate hinge.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you confirm the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before we do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, sure — what details do you want me to confirm?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you confirm the date, time, and exact drop-off spot for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, thank you. I’m thinking Saturday morning, maybe 9 to 11, so it doesn’t conflict with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning works for me—I can help keep it clear of pickup time. Want me to start spreading the word?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely — folks are signing up, and we’re just sorting out the last few jobs. If you want, I can fill you in on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please — I’d love the quick version so I can keep up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring or do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not set yet — I could really use your help organizing it. What should I do first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m glad it’s happening. I can help if you need a hand with anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the latest, but I’m glad folks are pitching in. How’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, it’s coming along all right—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies little by little. I’d better check the list again before I say too much, though.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good—no rush. Let me know if you need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure everyone knows when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and make a list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll tell the neighbors and remind them about the start time. If you make that list, I can help get the missing items covered.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll check in when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I knew I was forgetting something. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just bring whatever tools you’ve got and maybe some gloves — we’ll sort the rest when everyone gets there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it — I’ll grab my toolbox and a pair of gloves. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’s the one — community repairs. Just making sure we’re talking about the same drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, that’s the repair drive I meant. I can help with a quick check-in if needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks. I might have missed a change, so a quick check-in would help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a simple list and bring it by so we can keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — bring it by anytime, and we’ll get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara — could you help spread the word and check in on anyone who might want to bring tools or snacks? I’ll send the details your way right now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and check in with folks about tools or snacks. Send me the details when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need me to spread the word about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Please spread the word that we need volunteers at the community center on Saturday morning for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word that volunteers are needed at the community center on Saturday morning for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure thing — I can lend a hand if you need any tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I’m keeping a quick list, and I could use a hammer and a couple screwdrivers if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got a hammer and a couple screwdrivers you can borrow. I’ll set them aside for you now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s happening soon — I’m still catching up, so if you know the details, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still checking the details too — do you know what they’re fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not yet — I just know it’s the neighborhood repair drive. If you hear what they’re starting with, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep it simple. What do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Just a quick heads-up on your time and any tools you can bring would help a lot. I’ll coordinate the schedule around school pickup, so keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can do that — I’ll send you my time window and let you know what tools I’ve got. Thanks for working around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—can you confirm you’re coming by with the tools, or just helping sort donations?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m coming by with the tools and I can help sort donations too.
